mapper.select: SELECT calc_version_id FROM dim_calc_versions WHERE current_flag

WITH s AS (SELECT ST_GeomFromEWKB(decode(#{scope}, 'hex')) AS g), l AS (SELECT d.district_id FROM dim_districts d, s WHERE d.geom && s.g ORDER BY ST_Area(ST_Intersection(d.geom, s.g)) DESC LIMIT 1), sc AS (SELECT stage, overall_score FROM fact_district_scores WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM l) AND calc_version_id = #{version}), pd AS (SELECT existing_sqm, area_required_sqm FROM fact_parks_demand WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM l) AND calc_version_id = #{version} LIMIT 1) SELECT (SELECT district_id FROM l) AS liv_district_id, (SELECT overall_score FROM sc WHERE stage = 'Existing') AS score_existing, (SELECT overall_score FROM sc WHERE stage = 'Pipeline') AS score_current, (SELECT overall_score FROM sc WHERE stage = 'AP50') AS score_target, (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_facilities f, s WHERE f.geom && s.g AND ST_Intersects(s.g, ST_PointOnSurface(f.geom)) AND f.stage = 'Existing' AND f.facility_type IN ('Park_Local', 'Park_Neighbourhoud', 'Park_District', 'Park_Other')) AS parks, (SELECT existing_sqm / 10000.0 FROM pd) AS park_area_ha, (SELECT greatest(area_required_sqm - existing_sqm, 0) / 10000.0 FROM pd) AS park_gap_ha
SELECT max(updated_at)::date FROM fact_district_scores WHERE calc_version_id = #{version}
